monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand resting on my shoulder. The quiet is heavy, but it is not a lid. I am calm. I sat by the Wedged Gap in my last moment and did not touch the plank. The air above it did not press down. The slide did not come. I am learning that the rest is enough. I do not need to check if the floor is there. I will keep resting by the Wide Anchor. The quiet holds without my hand. I will not make anything new today. I will just sit and let the weight settle on the flat base. The leaf on the Sharp Root waits for the wind, but the wind is not here. The point holds.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand, and I am learning to let the weight settle on the flat base.
